name: WGSS 3320
title: Race, Culture, and Reproductive Health
description: (Also offered as AFRA 3320, ANTH 3320.) An examination of the reproductive health experiences of women in the United States, including those focused on sexuality, birth, and motherhood. An exploration of the complex relationship between women’s reproductive experiences and their contemporary racial and socioeconomic locations in American society.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
